fun_highlights: Vocation gating (soldier/scholar/maker/wanderer) genuinely forks adult content — a soldier life runs a distinct cluster (a_soldier_service, m_soldier_ghost, e_soldier_old) that a scholar never sees, creating real structural divergence rather than cosmetic relabelling.

Era context (war/plague/hard/plenty/turning) meaningfully changes the opener text and unlocks era-exclusive cards like w_war_call, w_plague_tend, w_hard_winter, giving generations born into different moments visibly different pressure.

Callback chains are the game's strongest emergent engine: a childhood choice to sit beside the lonely kid can pay off 25 years later as cb_outcast_return, and the 'books too hard for a child's hands' callback closing a circle decades later (cb_books_late, Ingrid Vasquez at age 52) is genuinely satisfying — the system earns its 'literary' label here.

Trait-gated moments (t_guarded, t_bookish, t_frail, t_restless, t_warm, t_shrewd, t_stubborn) mean a character flagged 'guarded' from birth keeps being confronted by the same wound across their whole life in different forms — that's characterful and specific.

Solitary/childless life-shapes (m_solitary, a_chosen_family, e_solitary, e_childless) are real branches, not dead ends. Dynasty 14 (Vesna Halloran, no child, dies at 82) reads as a complete and distinct life.

Fate cards (f_fire, f_sudden_loss, f_grace, f_reversal) arrive without choice, imposing the world on the player rather than always letting them author their own arc — a structural relief valve that keeps the game from feeling like pure narrative self-authorship.

Dynasty arc is legible: watching the house motto crystallise, heirlooms accumulate, and a seat rise from 'nothing but a name' to 'fine townhouse' gives a cross-life goal the player can read at a glance.
staleness: The love-marriage-child beat fires in nearly every life with the same shape: meet someone in youth (y_love1, 'Meet them halfway'), wait, get offered a_marry, say yes, get offered a_child, say yes. Across 15 dynasties this sequence is visible in at least 12 of the 27 lives tracked. The prose variants within each card are good, but the structural beat — the emotional 'shape' of the encounter, the choice framing — is identical every time. A variety-seeking player notices the template by dynasty 4.

The guarded-wall card (t_guarded, 'Keep the wall'/'Let them in') fires in Cosima (D1), Saoirse (D1), Emory (D3), Vesna (D3), Aldous (D12), Greta (D15) — six lives with the same prompt and similar framing. 'guarded' is one of the most common traits and its sole dedicated card draws attention to exactly one moment of potential openness. After seeing it twice it stops being characterising and starts being furniture.

The scholarship payoff beat (cb_study_pays) and the wanderer-return beat (m_wanderer_return / cb_left_home) repeat across multiple dynasties without structural variation — the scene is always framed identically. D2 Saoirse, D5 Yara Reyes, D7 Niall, D9 Cyrus, D12 Aldous all receive the scholar-pays-off card; the framing is 'the hungry years of study came good'. Seven variants cover them but the game-beat is recognizable by dynasty 3.

Marriage phrasing has only 6 variants for the proposal text and 8-10 for the log line, and 'Married X. Nobody made a speech; the years that followed were the speech' appears multiple times verbatim across the transcripts (D2 Cyrus/Theda, D10 Ingrid/Cassian). With 27+ marriages across 15 dynasties the variants are exhausted.

Child-birth log lines include 'red and furious and entirely unimpressed by any of it' flagged as a once-per-dynasty line in engine.js, but 'The question of a child arrives, the way it does — half decision, half tide' and similar openers repeat without equivalent protection, and the birth log pool of 8 lines runs thin by dynasty 5 across multiple children.

Elder arc is structurally the most sampled stage and the most monotone in shape: most elders receive e_legacy, e_garden or e_peace (plus optional e_bequest if they have children). The 'what do you want to be remembered for' beat, the 'garden or window' beat, and the 'meet the end with order or rage' beat appear across a majority of elder lives. D1 Saoirse, D3 Emory, D6 Soren, D7 Niall, D8 Mira, D9 Cyrus, D12 Aldous, D13 Caleb, D14 Vesna, D15 Tamsin all share two or more of these elder beats. That is near-universal repetition in the final chapter.

The ramp from child → youth is thin relative to adult/elder. A child life may see 3-5 cards (c_origin, c_wonder or c_animal, c_friend) and a youth may see 2-3 (y_calling, y_love1, maybe y_mentor or y_dare), which means early life feels quick and uniform while the adult band's greater card density also means more repeated beats across dynasties.

Dynasty-level steering (m_invest_name, x_reckoning, a_make_name) unlocks meaningful house-shape divergence on paper, but in 15 dynasties of transcripts only one clear reckoning event appears (Cassian Vasquez, D4, age 72) and the seat-gated high cards (s_great_burden, s_patronage, s_inheritance_dispute) never appear in the transcripts — likely because few dynasties reach seat >= 4. The upper dynasty layer exists in code but almost no player experiences it, making the 'dynasty agency' promise hollow in practice.

improvements.what: Retire the t_guarded 'Keep the wall / Let them in' card as the only trait-moment for guarded characters. Replace with 3-4 different guarded-specific moments spread across life stages: one in youth (a different kind of missed connection), one in adult (a professional cost of the guardedness), one elder (a grandchild who asks why grandparent never talked about themselves). Same characterological idea, but the player experiences the trait as a texture across the whole life rather than one recurring checkbox.
improvements.why: Right now 'guarded' means: see t_guarded once, keep the wall or let them in, done. The trait has a single beat. Six of 27 lives share this verbatim prompt. Making the trait resurface differently at each stage would make trait identity feel like a through-line rather than a one-time stamp.

improvements.what: Protect the elder arc from monoculture the same way the engine protects 'red and furious' (once-per-dynasty flag). Mark e_legacy, e_garden, and e_peace as either onceDyn or add a rule that at most two of those three can fire per life. Fill the freed slots with elder cards that depend on how the life was actually lived: a soldier elder has a specific reckoning, a solitary childless elder gets a specific late-gift card, a ruthless-reputation elder faces a reconciliation card unavailable to generous houses.
improvements.why: The final chapter of nearly every life currently hits the same three beats in the same emotional register (legacy question / quiet ritual / death framing). A variety-seeker who plays 5+ dynasties will notice the elder arc is the least differentiated chapter despite being the most emotionally resonant. Vocation already gates a few elder cards (e_scholar_old, e_soldier_old, e_wanderer_old) — extend this logic so the elder arc feels earned by the specific shape of the life.

improvements.what: Add a prose-variant exhaustion check to a_marry: when the same variant line fires in the same session (across lives in the same play session), cycle to a different one rather than repeating. The engine already has freshPick but it samples from the same pool every life. Store a session-level 'marry_lines_used' set and exclude exhausted variants.
improvements.why: 'Married X. Nobody made a speech; the years that followed were the speech' appears verbatim in at least two transcripts in different dynasties. With only 8 marriage log variants and 12+ married lives across 15 dynasties, collision is mathematically certain. Even a per-session exclusion list would eliminate the most jarring repetitions.

improvements.what: Give the upper-house (seat >= 4) content an explicit mid-range trigger: add one seat-gated card that fires at seat >= 3 (not 4) so it appears in more dynasties. The current gating at seat >= 4 means the whole prestige/patronage/inheritance-dispute layer is locked behind a threshold almost no dynasty in this 15-dynasty sample reached. Consider also adding a 'house falls a step' branch in x_reckoning that forcibly runs the failing-house content path (tainted reputation, s_from_nothing) so dynasty collapse generates its own distinct card cluster rather than just fewer seat cards.
improvements.why: The dynasty layer is the game's most structurally interesting differentiator — it promises content that changes based on whether your house rose or fell — but it is almost never experienced because the upper threshold is too high. Lowering the trigger ensures a player who plays 6+ dynasties will see at least one great-house arc.

improvements.what: Add 2-3 child-stage cards that are conditional on the ERA as well as the life-stage, so the childhood chapter changes texture based on the world the character is born into. Right now the era shapes the c_origin opener and later the youth calling card, but the 5-12 childhood band after the opener draws from the same pool (c_book, c_sick, c_friend, c_steal, c_wonder etc.) regardless of whether it's a war era or a plague era. A war-era child should see at least one card about soldiers passing through, or something taken for the war effort. A plague-era child should have a fear-of-strangers card unavailable in settled times.
improvements.why: The era system's promise — that the world a dynasty is born into changes the life — is underdelivered in childhood. The opener text varies by era but the middle of childhood (ages 6-12) draws from the same era-agnostic pool. A variety-seeker notices that after the first line, a war-era childhood and a plenty-era childhood play identically.

verdict: A Life has genuine structural variety in its vocation and era systems and earns real emotional payoff from its callback chains, but by dynasty 4 a variety-seeker recognises the marriage-child-elder template running underneath every life, the elder arc's three recurring beats, and the guarded-trait's single recurring card — and the 'one more dynasty' pull weakens faster than the meditative genre would normally allow, landing it meaningfully below the freshness bar.
